meta.note: Only figures stated in the brief are populated. Per-category penetration beyond Frozen Food, and per-district shares beyond Bengaluru, are null until the full census dataset is baked in during a later pass.

concentration.insight: Extreme concentration — nearly three in five GT outlets sit in a single district.

categories.name: OTC
categories.note: One of the two major whitespace opportunities.

recommendations.title: Win Bengaluru first, then radiate
recommendations.body: With ~59% of GT outlets in one district, a Karnataka entry is really a Bengaluru entry. Concentrate distribution muscle where the density already is, then step out to Tier-2/3 towns from that base.

recommendations.title: Lead with Frozen Food and OTC
recommendations.body: Frozen Food sits near ~90% white space and OTC is the other major gap. These are the categories where a new entrant meets the least incumbency and the most room to define the shelf.

recommendations.title: Buy depth, not just doors, in Tier-3
recommendations.body: Tier-3 towns carry deeper assortment opportunity than their outlet counts suggest. Reward each outlet with a wider, better-merchandised range rather than chasing raw store count alone.
